text:
The bowl looks about 15 cm across, or perhaps a little smaller. It holds a few dumplings, probably 3-4, one green (spinach wrapper) and one white. They are topped with sliced radish, chopped nuts or fried garlic, and some sauce.

A dumpling weighs roughly 25-30 g, so 4 come to about 110 g. The sauce, nuts and radish add about 30 g, for a total of about 140 g.

At about 1.7 kcal/g for the dumplings plus the added oil and nuts, that is roughly 230 kcal.
